name: YT Widget
author: Pursuit2703
description: Native plain-YouTube player for Omarchy. Search, playlists, queue, EQ, spectrum, mini player. Local mpv + yt-dlp, no browser, no login.

barWidget.description: Native YouTube player with search, queue, EQ, and local mpv playback.

schema.label: Stop local playback when idle
schema.description: Minutes. Use 0 to keep the backend running after you pause.

schema.label: Bar title width
schema.description: How much room the title gets. The hover controls need about 128, so much above that leaves a gap in the bar while you hover the chip. The title scrolls, so a narrow window still reads.

schema.label: Crossfade between tracks
schema.description: Milliseconds. The outgoing track fades down over its last moments and the next one fades up. Use 0 for hard cuts.

schema.label: Subtitle language
schema.description: Language code preferred when the video window loads subtitles, e.g. en, es, ar. Falls back to auto-generated captions.

schema.label: Video quality
schema.description: Preferred height in pixels for the video window. The closest available rung at or below this is used, and you can change it live from the Quality menu while watching.

schema.label: Video window size
schema.description: Percent of the screen the video window may fill when it opens. It is never scaled up past the video's own size.

schema.label: Video GPU
schema.description: "integrated" pins the video window to the built-in GPU, which starts faster and more consistently and leaves a discrete card asleep. Use "default" to let mpv choose (it prefers the discrete GPU).

schema.label: Spectrum across the bar
schema.description: Draw the spectrum in the empty parts of the bar while something is playing. The music note in the widget's hover controls toggles it for the session; this is the state it starts in.

schema.label: Bar spectrum height
schema.description: Percent of the bar's height at full level.
